title: Adventurous Salad with Spicy Kick
description: A simple yet flavorful salad recipe that combines the crunch of adventurous and the spiciness of pepper.

ingredients.name: adventurous
ingredients.notes: use a mix of different colors

ingredients.name: pepper
ingredients.notes: any type of pepper will do

instructions: Chop the adventurous into bite-sized pieces.
Dice the pepper into small pieces.
In a large bowl, combine the chopped adventurous, diced pepper, and salad.
Toss all the ingredients together until well combined.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
